remarks: Move-in-ready, renovated New Canaan charmer. This three-bedroom home is a true gem, featuring 1930s vintage architectural details alongside extensive recent updates. Key highlights of the property include: Main Level: An updated kitchen with top-of-the-line stainless appliances and a sitting island, opens to the dining room, and a living room. Easy access to outdoor patio. Second Floor: An owner suite with hardwood floors and a large walk-in closet, plus two additional bedrooms, a full bath, and a large linen closet. Lower Level: A finished recreational playroom, laundry area, workroom, and storage closet. Additional Storage: Plentiful space in the walk-up attic.  Exterior: A level backyard with a two-car garage and a private courtyard patio, perfect for relaxation and entertaining. Ideally located for commuters, this home offers easy access to West Elementary School, the town center, Metro-North, and the Parkway.
